test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) . Only C sits between G and E. E sits third to the left of F. D sits to the immediate left of F. B is not an immediate neighbour of E.

Who sits second to the right of A?
solution:
Given, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) .

E sits third to the left of F.

D sits to the immediate left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/668aa8d7d7e73a2d8adb1d53c621b549a830e16fed2b05b925f518f14b2b3753.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0167f3222d9333770308ded8f11e8808af57961a9ae0670c6f8f7bdc902a0901.png] 

Only C sits between G and E.

B is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0f5147ea56cba20173977e0429fa7a97bd63b690ee15042e4b0f4f872d10028.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef1c0e31207fba8a05d5e5d90ec014bd2391a7aa3227f95d896e93640b5adda.png] 

And A sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e2f519d2ad17c1eb5d9e724b180e030aa94aefdf4264b4d60239c9e7cee4a9a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f68993b180848f7884895ab5d11516c63ae8f79981a7bcef175dfc2f788c83c.png] 

So, **F** sits second to the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
